_meta.name: Can Name All Three Branches (phone era)
_meta.unit: percent of adults naming all three branches (telephone survey)
_meta.source: Annenberg Public Policy Center, Constitution Day Civics Survey
_meta.note: Same question as appcBranchesWeb, asked by telephone (RDD/CATI, ~1,000–1,400 adults) from 2006 through 2022. The series ends in 2022 when APPC moved to its online panel; APPC's 2022 parallel run (47% phone vs 72% online) measured a ~25-point mode effect, which is why the eras are separate series. Not asked 2007–2010 or 2012.
_meta.method: transcribed from the CIVI3/CIVI4 summary table, p.2 of APPC's September 2022 appendix PDF (read 2026-08-31)
